name: Open URL: hourglass (wait) over the whole page while the file is downloaded, converted and drawn; normal cursor afterwards
eval: window.__B = { wait: (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)), cls: () => ['busy', 'busy-wait'].filter(c => document.documentElement.classList.contains(c)), cur: () => getComputedStyle(document.getElementById('map')).cursor + '/' + getComputedStyle(document.getElementById('btn-open')).cursor }; const before = { cls: __B.cls(), cur: __B.cur() }; const p = openFromUrl(location.origin + '/tests/fixtures/vracov-5.5km.gpx'); const during = { cls: __B.cls(), cur: __B.cur() }; await p; return { before, during, after: { cls: __B.cls(), cur: __B.cur() }, opened: !!gpx && trackLines.length > 0 }

name: Open (local file, drag and drop, share, Open with): hourglass while the file is read and converted, the work starts only after the cursor has been drawn
eval: const text = await (await fetch('/tests/fixtures/vracov-out-and-back.gpx')).text(); let resolve; const read = new Promise(r => resolve = r); const p = openText(read, { fileName: 'oab.gpx' }); await __B.wait(20); const reading = __B.cls(); const name0 = gpx.fileName; resolve(text); await Promise.resolve(); const beforePaint = gpx.fileName === name0; await p; return { reading, beforePaint, opened: gpx.fileName, after: __B.cls() }

name: Generate turns: arrow with hourglass (progress) while the road data load; the map can still be moved
eval: await openFromUrl(location.origin + '/tests/fixtures/vracov-5.5km.gpx'); const p = generateTurns(); const during = { cls: __B.cls(), cur: __B.cur() }; await p; return { during, after: __B.cls(), turns: wptItems.filter(w => typeCat(w.type) === 'turn').length > 0 }

name: … then the hourglass (wait) while the turns are computed and written – also when the road data are already stored (long routes); the computation starts only after the cursor has been drawn
eval: const orig = computeTurns; let at = null, painted = false; computeTurns = (...a) => { at = { cls: __B.cls(), cur: __B.cur(), painted }; return orig(...a); }; await openFromUrl(location.origin + '/tests/fixtures/vracov-5.5km.gpx'); const p = generateTurns(); const progress = document.getElementById('gen-progress'); let text = ''; for (let i = 0; i < 200 && !at; i++) { await new Promise(r => requestAnimationFrame(r)); painted = __B.cls().includes('busy-wait'); if (painted && !text) text = progress.textContent; } await p; computeTurns = orig; return { at, text, after: __B.cls() }

name: Route planner: progress while GraphHopper is asked (also while points clicked meanwhile wait for the next request), normal cursor when all segments are found
eval: saveJSON(GH_KEY_KEY, 'k1'); PLAN_GAP_MS = 0; gpx = null; setGpx(null, { fit: false }); __gh.mode = 'hold'; __gh.requests.length = 0; document.getElementById('btn-new').click(); await __B.wait(50); const click = (lat, lng) => { const ll = L.latLng(lat, lng); map.fire('click', { latlng: ll, containerPoint: map.latLngToContainerPoint(ll) }); }; click(48.98, 17.23); const one = __B.cls(); click(48.99, 17.24); await __B.wait(30); const held = __B.cls(); click(49.0, 17.25); __gh.mode = 'ok'; __gh.release(); await __B.wait(150); const r = { one, held, after: __B.cls(), ok: plan.segs.length === 2 && plan.segs.every(s => s.state === 'ok') }; closePlan(); return r
